title: A coffee shrub hedge-pruned flat on one side
prompt: Write an L-system as JSON with the keys axiom, rules, angle, iterations and start_heading for a coffee shrub that has been hedge-pruned flat along one side. F and G draw forward, f moves without drawing, + and - turn by the angle, [ and ] save and restore position.
groundTruth: The JSON expanded and drawn with turtle graphics offline, and the drawing judged by eye. There is no single right L-system, so nothing here is measured.

checks.label: Reads as a shrub
checks.how: A recognisable branching shrub in the drawing.
checks.rule: Pass if it reads as one plant with branches coming off stems, without being told what it is. A tangle, a lattice or loops fail it.

checks.label: Flat side from the rules
checks.how: One side cut flat by branches the rules make shorter, and no clipping.
checks.rule: Pass if one side ends on a straight line that the rules themselves put there. A box drawn around the plant to cut it fails it.

checks.label: Sensible size
checks.how: A sensible number of iterations and segments for what is drawn.
checks.rule: Pass if the branches can still be followed by eye. So many segments that they merge into a mass fails it.

harder: Pruned flat on top as well as one side, so two cuts have to come out of the rules at once.
